version_target: current_observed_deployment; historical binding must be independently established
window_policy: After one shared finalized discovery, record the last 500 inclusive blocks ending at that returned height before any event reads; discovery errors leave window null. Never silently expand.
shared_reads_accounting: Charge each shared read to CASE-002 only; other cases reference its ledger without duplicating reads or counts.
rules: Read only; no credentials, paid services, signing, broadcast or cloud deployment
Preserve failed, missing and excluded candidates; choose first eligible in fixed order
Latest-only state is acquisition-time observation, not historical block or transaction prestate
No new M1 claims without decisive historical inputs and independent expected results
selection_rule: first ordinary losing close and first liquidation in fixed order, with cash/debt and queue branches classified only with evidence
